name: Repair and Maintenance Gantries
desc:
An array of specialized gantries to aid in ship maintenance both in dry dock and in the void.

This hullmod decreases the maintenance supply consumption of each ship in the fleet by %s/%s/%s/%s supplies/month for each ship carrying it, depending on that ship's hull size.

This hullmod cannot reduce a ship's maintenance supply consumption by more than %s, rounded up.

Doubles the minimum crew required by this ship.
short: Reduces maintenance supply use of every ship in the fleet.
